name: ENVE 4910W
title: Environmental Engineering Design I
description: Students working individually or in groups produce solution to environmental engineering design projects from data acquisition through preliminary design, cost estimating and final specifications, oral presentation and written reports.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; ENVE 3120; ENVE 3220, which may be taken concurrently; open to seniors.
